claim: The underlying GRASS market move occurred
observed_evidence: The asset showed the material market movement underlying the viral performance narrative
supported_inference: The underlying market event was real
counterevidence: Asset movement does not identify which actor captured the move
not_established: Agent participation; claimed entry; claimed exit; claimed profit
limitation: Historical market movement alone cannot reconstruct actor performance

claim: An autonomous Grok agent turned 0.3 ETH into approximately 19.7 ETH
observed_evidence: A public first-person performance claim and video describe the trade, but no public trading wallet plus entry and exit transaction path was identified
supported_inference: The performance claim was publicly made
counterevidence: The underlying token movement was real
not_established: That the trade was false; that it never occurred; intent or fabrication
limitation: Failure to reconstruct is not proof of non-occurrence

claim: The published GRASS safety description accurately represented the token's launch architecture
observed_evidence: The claim described an LP-burn style safety property while Pons v2 documentation describes bonding-curve graduation into permanently locked full-range Uniswap v4 liquidity
supported_inference: The published safety wording did not cleanly match the documented launch architecture
counterevidence: Individual security properties may still have been valid; wording may have been generic
not_established: Fabrication; malicious intent; invalidity of every safety check
limitation: The mismatch does not independently establish whether the trade occurred

claim: Multiple accounts independently reported their own MEMEMOON bot-performance event
observed_evidence: Highly specific first-person performance narratives appeared across multiple accounts with the same unusual trade details and small mutations
supported_inference: The apparent independence of the published narratives is materially weakened
counterevidence: Some instances may be affected by repost or archive ambiguity
not_established: Common account control; coordinated fraud; fabrication of the underlying trade; shared wallet control
limitation: Direct-original captures are preferred over archives where available

claim: The published Zynex MEMEMOON execution description is internally consistent
observed_evidence: The same first-person account states a 0.5 SOL entry and later states that position size never exceeds 0.1 SOL
supported_inference: The published description contains a material internal contradiction
counterevidence: An undocumented configuration change or exception could theoretically explain the difference
not_established: Fabrication; non-occurrence of the trade; common control
limitation: No transaction-level reconstruction was completed

claim: The KITSUNE autonomous-trading claim can be independently reconstructed
observed_evidence: The claim gives precise entry size, market-cap levels, profit and audit language, but the reviewed material did not provide a unique contract, trading wallet, buy hash and sell hash
supported_inference: The claim has substantially greater precision than its available audit trail
counterevidence: Missing public identifiers do not prove the event did not occur
not_established: That the claim was false; that no KITSUNE trade occurred
limitation: Underlying token identity remained unresolved in the reviewed evidence

claim: Claimed realized profits closely track headline market-cap multiples
observed_evidence: For both claims, multiplying entry capital by the stated market-cap multiple produces a result close to the claimed realized return
supported_inference: The similarity is an indicator warranting provenance and execution scrutiny
counterevidence: Fees; slippage; liquidity; partial exits; position mechanics can create legitimate differences
not_established: Fabrication; templating; common operator; false performance
limitation: Arithmetic similarity is not transaction evidence
primary_source: Derived from published GRASS and KITSUNE figures

claim: RoundtableSpace amplified a Grok-agent token-factory narrative later referenced downstream
observed_evidence: A captured RoundtableSpace post amplified the narrative and FACTORY metadata later referenced the same status ID
supported_inference: Amplification increased distribution and later became part of downstream provenance
counterevidence: RoundtableSpace covers a broad range of AI and technology content and is not reducible to this category
verdict_scope: Public amplification and downstream provenance only
not_established: Financial coordination; knowledge of falsity; payment; token-launch participation
limitation: Reach effects are not independently quantified

claim: Amplified Enko / AI-agent material became part of a tradable token's public provenance
observed_evidence: FACTORY metadata referenced Enko material, Enko's GitHub identity and a specific RoundtableSpace post
supported_inference: Upstream creator and amplifier content was incorporated into the asset's metadata layer
counterevidence: Metadata citation does not show who approved or requested the references
not_established: That Enko created the token; that RoundtableSpace created or approved it; that either received compensation
limitation: Metadata does not establish off-chain relationships or intent

claim: Pump.fun supports creator-fee and fee-sharing infrastructure
observed_evidence: Primary Pump.fun documentation describes creator-fee and sharing mechanisms including configurable recipients
supported_inference: The platform provides technical infrastructure capable of routing creator-related fees
counterevidence: Protocol capability does not establish that any specific token used the mechanism or that any named recipient was paid
not_established: Specific token configuration; specific payout; amount received; beneficiary identity
limitation: Mint-specific configuration and payout require separate reconstruction

not_established: Absence of all prior communication; identity of token launcher; common control; motive

counterevidence: The public record does not provide a complete private communication history
not_established: Pre-launch coordination; common control; verified creator-fee payout; identity of launcher; motive

claim: Creator fees from SPIDER were paid to Phosphen
observed_evidence: Public statements describe creator-fee routing and later claim / onboarding, but no complete mint-to-recipient payout path was reconstructed
supported_inference: A payout is publicly asserted but not independently reconstructed
counterevidence: Protocol capability exists, but mint-specific configuration and recipient wallet were not reconstructed
not_established: Amount paid; recipient wallet; claim transaction; payout timing

counterevidence: Private communication or prior awareness cannot be fully excluded

observed_evidence: Public statements describe fee redirection and later claim, but the complete payout path was not reconstructed
supported_inference: A payout is publicly asserted but not independently reconstructed
counterevidence: Protocol capability exists, but recipient mapping and claim transaction were not reconstructed
not_established: Actual recipient wallet; amount received; exact claim transaction; pre-launch financial relationship

claim: Post-launch creator onboarding is observable across more than one independent case
observed_evidence: SPIDER and REAPER each show a public chronology in which a creator describes a token as externally initiated and is subsequently shown publicly associated with the same token
supported_inference: A recurring post-launch onboarding mechanism is supported in the observed cases
counterevidence: The public record cannot exclude private pre-launch contact in either case
verdict_scope: Recurring post-launch onboarding mechanism in observed cases
not_established: Universal prevalence; single operator; common control; verified payouts; fraudulent intent

claim: The public Orbital post associated with HIVEMIND preceded the indexed token creation time by less than one minute
observed_evidence: Orbital X status 2094086697256427897 decodes to 2026-08-30 15:35:49.532 UTC; indexed token creation is 2026-08-30 15:36:43 UTC; difference approximately 53.468 seconds
supported_inference: The observable public-post and indexed token-creation events occurred in very close temporal proximity
counterevidence: Short latency is compatible with automation, manual rapid response, prior preparation or prior knowledge
not_established: Automation; pre-coordination; common control; causality; who initiated creation
limitation: Token creation time relies on an indexed token record rather than independently reconstructed Solana creation transaction

claim: Narrative-linked launches consistently occur within seconds of the referenced public post
observed_evidence: HIVEMIND shows approximately 53.5 seconds while GBC shows approximately 16 minutes 2 seconds between referenced post and indexed creation
supported_inference: Observed latency varies materially between identified cases
counterevidence: Variation does not exclude automation or coordination in individual cases
not_established: Absence of automation; absence of coordination; manual launch process; causality
limitation: Only a small number of source-verified cases are compared
primary_source: Derived from HIVEMIND and GBC timestamp records

claim: The observed creators, amplifiers, token launchers and onboarding accounts form one coordinated operation
observed_evidence: No complete evidentiary chain establishing common control or a coordinated operation was identified; SPIDER and REAPER are compatible with third-party launch followed by later creator adoption
supported_inference: The observed mechanism does not require pre-launch creator coordination or common control
counterevidence: Repeated wallet activity, narrative reuse and short-latency events can make coordination plausible in individual subcases
not_established: That no coordination occurred anywhere; that all actors were independent
limitation: Public evidence cannot exclude undisclosed private relationships

claim: Multiple observed cases support a recurring market mechanism in which viral AI / technical narratives can be amplified, tokenized and followed by creator onboarding
observed_evidence: Independent cases document recycled performance narratives, amplification, token metadata reuse, fee infrastructure, repeat tokenization and creator-onboarding sequences
supported_inference: A recurring structural mechanism is supported without requiring one operator
counterevidence: The full population of launches was not reconstructed and not every case contains every stage
verdict_scope: Recurring structural mechanism in observed cases only
not_established: Population prevalence; universal workflow; single operator; fraud rate; common intent; causal explanation of GRASS
